verdict: Prismatic Evolutions is holding value better: PRIS25 98.04 vs DR25 95.75 since the Aug 24 launch at 100.00 (Sep 21 mark), with the only up week of the two (+1.3%); its top three chase cards sum to $1,788.53 vs $758.78 (Umbreon ex SIR $1,069.03 vs Team Rocket's Mewtwo ex SIR $423.00, 30-sale medians read Sep 26). Destined Rivals is the cheaper entry (ETB lowest ask $119.90 vs $133.00; bundle $50.00 vs $75.00).
